chain.title: A Message from Below
chain.desc: Search underground cabins for Cave Tablets. Each tablet begins research into a specific rare cave biome.

chain.title: Decipher the Tablet
chain.desc: Build a Spelunkery Table and bring the tablet with its required research supplies. Complete its word puzzle to recover the cave knowledge.

chain.title: Knowledge Made Portable
chain.desc: Finish deciphering a tablet to obtain a Cave Codex. Codices connect your research to the Cave Book and biome-finding map workflow.
chain.acquisition: Produced by decoding a Cave Tablet with paper at the Spelunkery Table. Verified in Alex's Caves 2.0.2: assets/alexscaves/books/en_us/root.txt and server.inventory.SpelunkeryTableMenu, which constructs CAVE_CODEX.

chain.title: Follow the Research
chain.desc: Make a Cave Map for the biome you researched. Each expedition below is a separate branch; one cave's boss does not unlock all the others.
chain.acquisition: Crafted from a Cave Codex and paper by the coded alexscaves:cave_map recipe. Verified in Alex's Caves 2.0.2: assets/alexscaves/books/en_us/root.txt and server.recipe.RecipeCaveMap, which constructs CAVE_MAP and calls CaveMapItem.createMap.

chain.title: Metal of the Magnetic Caves
chain.desc: Explore the Magnetic Caves and smelt their azure neodymium. Keep tools and loose materials secure while investigating magnetic machinery.

chain.title: Put Magnetism to Work
chain.desc: Craft an Azure Magnet using the installed recipe. Experiment with a small setup before building a larger magnetic contraption.

chain.title: The Machine Reassembles
chain.desc: Defeat a Magnetron in the Magnetic Caves. It builds its body from nearby blocks, and dangerous blocks can make the encounter harder.

chain.title: The Heart Left Behind
chain.desc: Recover the Heart of Iron after the Magnetron falls apart. Look for the block it leaves behind rather than assuming it appears as ordinary inventory loot.

chain.title: A Peaceful Primordial Visit
chain.desc: Prepare Serene Salad for the Primordial Caves. Read its effect and use it while investigating the biome's dinosaurs and resources.

chain.title: An Offering to the Volcano
chain.desc: Prepare an Ominous Catalyst and locate a Primordial Caves volcano. Set up your equipment and escape space before waking what is inside.

chain.title: Wake the Volcano
chain.desc: Toss the catalyst into the volcano's top to start the encounter. Defeat the Luxtructosaurus while avoiding its eruptions, stomps and destructive attacks.

chain.title: Spirits of the Lost Herd
chain.desc: Recover Tectonic Shards from the boss and craft an Extinction Spear. This is the Primordial route's weapon goal.

chain.title: Prepare for Toxic Air
chain.desc: Assemble radiation protection before handling the Toxic Caves' hazards. A mask is one part of the equipment plan, not a promise of complete protection on its own.

chain.title: Handle with Care
chain.desc: Gather uranium in the Toxic Caves once your protection is ready. Check the Nuclear Furnace and other installed recipes before choosing what to build.

chain.title: Equip for the Abyss
chain.desc: Prepare diving equipment for the Abyssal Chasm. Plan oxygen, visibility and a return route before descending into its deep water.

chain.title: Trade in the Deep
chain.desc: Obtain pearls in the Abyssal Chasm and inspect the local trading and crafting opportunities. Deep One reputation matters during this expedition.

chain.title: A Place for Deep Offerings
chain.desc: Build an Abyssal Altar using the installed recipe. Explore its offering interaction with the Deep Ones rather than treating it as a furnace.

chain.title: The Forlorn Ritual
chain.desc: Investigate Underzealot rituals involving Vespers in the Forlorn Hollows. Defeat the resulting Forsaken; direct light helps against its late-fight regeneration.

chain.title: Shape the Darkness
chain.desc: Collect Pure Darkness from the Forsaken and use it for a Dreadbow. This finishes the Forlorn combat branch.

chain.title: Across the Candy Ravines
chain.desc: Explore the Candy Cavity and craft a Candy Cane Hook. Use it to cross the biome's steep formations while keeping an eye on hostile candy creatures.

chain.title: Reshape a Small Corner of the World
chain.desc: Obtain a Conversion Crucible and learn the Biome Treat workflow. Bind a treat in the target biome, then fulfill the crucible's requested materials.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Cave research followed by independent Magnetic, Primordial, Toxic, Abyssal, Forlorn and Candy branches.
coverage.limitations: Data and bundled cave-book mechanics checked against 2.0.2. Candy Cavity content is conditional on version. Research items may carry biome data; these general item milestones do not assert a specific NBT variant.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
